newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEDO tenders to buy Nov fuel oil for North Korea.
newsitem.headline: KEDO tenders to buy Nov fuel oil for North Korea.

text.p: The Korean Peninsular Energy Development Organisation (KEDO) has issued a tender to buy November fuel oil, industry sources said on Tuesday.

The tender, to close November 6, seeks 42,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent sulphur grade heavy residual fuel oil for delivery between November 10-29 to the ports of Sonbong, Nampo, or Songrim in North Korea.
Bids should be valid until November 7.
KEDO last purchased a total of 80,000 tonnes of October fuel oil at $123.50-$126.00 per tonne on a free-on-board fob Okinawa basis.
KEDO, an international organization established to implement nuclear non-proliferation in North Korea, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
